# Native PropAMM evidence

- `accounts.json`: copied from `arch-swap-router/tests/fixtures/prop_amm`,
  router revision `63c37f5`, generated from PropAMM `734a9066d6f9fddce321cd9c2ade8c8a38e41ac6`
  with `arch_program` 0.10.0. Includes synthetic PDA cases; its mainnet placeholder
  is fixture data, not an enabled SDK deployment.
- `trades.json`: the two testnet cases from that directory's native trades fixture,
  omitting the standalone account list. The 50-byte native CPI retains original
  compact terms, measured input and minimum. The router encodes only the terms.
- `router-transactions.json`: copied unchanged from `prop-amm-router-signing`
  revision `a7ccb99`, `server/tests/fixtures/router-transactions.json`.
  Eight signed Rust transactions cover Buy/Sell × swap, redeem/swap, swap/mint,
  redeem/swap/mint, using input ATA + router instructions. Generated by
  `Fixture::new(side, redeem, mint, false, false)` in router `63c37f5`,
  `tests/runtime/src/fixtures.rs`, then hex-encoding `fixture.tx.serialize()`.
  Router SDK 0.8.7/runtime SDK 0.9.0 produced the wire bytes; signing-server tests
  decode with SDK 0.10.0 and verify both original signatures. All keys are public
  deterministic test identities, with a fixed clock and synthetic state.

SDK tests reconstruct instructions and compare the entire compiled message and
serialized transaction to these Rust bytes. They include both signatures in size
measurement; the three-hop cases are 1,225 bytes with shared fee destinations.
Tests do not read sibling checkouts or establish live deployment compatibility.
